conditions.quote_anchor: I'm trying to identify a trend

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote states directly that the trader is identifying a trend, which is exactly the condition.

conditions.quote_anchor: we'll start with just I'm trying to identify a trend

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: 'we'll start with ... identify a trend' faithfully expresses that the strategy begins with trend identification.

conditions.quote_anchor: And all I need is two touch points to draw a trend line.

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote states the two-touch-point minimum for drawing the trend line; the parenthetical labels are naming, not added substance.

conditions.quote_anchor: trying to capture as many touch points as I can

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: 'trying to capture as many touch points as I can' is the same drawing preference the condition states.

conditions.quote_anchor: every time price gets to or close enough to the trend line, you're thinking it's going to respect it and you get into that trade

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote gives the trigger verbatim: price reaching or getting close enough to the line, expecting respect, then entering.

conditions.quote_anchor: looking for places to buy when price gets to a trend line close enough

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote grounds entry on price getting close enough to the trend line; the condition only generalizes 'buy' to 'entry'.

conditions.quote_anchor: So, we've got action and safety. This one tells me when to place a trade and this one tells me how I'm going to manage my risk and when I'm going to exit.

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote describes two distinct lines with separate roles, whereas the condition claims one trend line is designated as both.

conditions.quote_anchor: it has to have three or more touch points

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: 'it has to have three or more touch points' states the requirement directly, if anything more strongly than the condition's 'should'.

conditions.quote_anchor: the safety line, this is what mitigates our risk. This is what tells us if it's high risk or low risk. This is this tells us how long to stay in.

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote assigns risk mitigation and exit timing to the safety line, exactly as the condition states.
